decisions.reason: The high-resolution piezo printer is core hardware with heavy in-house development investment and fits the firm's established coding portfolio, so management persists and treats any weak uptake as temporary, pandemic-related ramp-up.
The publicly announced numbering module directly serves the declared serialization and traceability direction, so dropping it would contradict the firm's stated strategy.
The coder for non-absorbent surfaces builds on the firm's core ink expertise and its one-stop promise, so sunk costs and strategic centrality favor continuation.
The CodeScan app was visibly launched on its own page as the successor to PharmaScan and supports code verification and traceability, so management sticks with it despite modest direct revenue.
Inline code verification is central to the announced end-to-end traceability direction and builds on established systems, so the commitment remains strong.
The layout design software was showcased on the home page and underpins common operation across systems, making it a publicly committed part of the firm's digitalization path.
